The City of La Habra Heights complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require special assistance to attend or participate in this meeting, please call the City Clerkâ€™s office at (562) 694-6302.
Materials related to any items on this agenda submitted to the Roads Advisory Committee after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection at the City Clerkâ€™s Office at 1245 N. Hacienda Road, La Habra Heights, CA 90631 during normal business hours.
PUBLIC COMMENT PROCESS
Social distancing is still required inside City Hall. The public may physically attend City Road Advisory Committee meetings. Due to limited designated seating, members of the public will be allowed to enter on a first come, first served basis. To protect Committee Members, members of the public and staff, face masks are required for all unvaccinated individuals and for staff. Members of the public who are vaccinated can enter City Hall without a mask if proof of vaccination is provided. The City will evaluate the current circumstances before each meeting to decide if it is safe to change ongoing COVID-19 safety protocols in place. Members of the public may also go to www.Lhhcity.org to view the live broadcast of the Road Advisory Committee meeting.
The public may provide public comments on any agenda item or item not on the agenda during Item No. 4, PUBLIC COMMENTS, via phone at (562) 694-6302 Ext. 0. If you would like to provide public comment via telephone, please begin your call once the Chair calls the meeting to order.
Each member of the public may speak for a total of five minutes on any action item listed on the agenda or other matters within the Roads Advisory Committee's purview.
To speak in the Public Comment segment please complete and deliver a speakerâ€™s card to the Clerk prior to the call for public comments. You will be called to the podium by name when it is your turn to speak. Be advised that the Chair may limit speaking time at his discretion.
Should you need to provide written documentation, please give the Clerk a minimum of FIFTEEN (15) copies prior to the start of the meeting so the information can be distributed to the Committee.
